maddeler.e: اِقْتَنَى • (iqtanā) VIII (non-past يَقْتَنِي (yaqtanī), verbal noun اِقْتِنَاء (iqtināʔ))
maddeler.t: Compare Akkadian qanûm (“to keep possession of, to acquire, to buy”), Aramaic קנא (qnɑʔ, “to get, to gain, to obtain, to possess”) and Hebrew קָנָה (kaná, “to buy, to purchase”).
s: Akkadian qanûm (“to keep possession of, to acquire, to buy”)
Aramaic קנא (qnɑʔ, “to get, to gain, to obtain, to possess”)
